pkg(pypi): tag linux wheels as musllinux compatible (#1605)

The bundled linux binaries are statically linked (CGO_ENABLED=0), so the
existing wheels also run on musl. Adding musllinux_1_1 to their compressed
platform tag lets pip and uv install lefthook on Alpine, where there was
previously no matching distribution. glibc installs are unaffected.
